day_shape: 44 items dominated by Khamenei farewell coverage from Tehran with 100+ diplomatic delegations claimed and a leaked German report projecting up to 3,000 possible deaths, plus Ayalon calling the reported US-Iran deal a 'massive surrender'; nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Khamenei farewell ceremony logistics
threads.summary: Iranian state broadcaster IRIB and IRGC-affiliated Defa Press ran continuous coverage of the farewell at Tehran's Imam Khomeini prayer ground, with the cabinet declaring Sunday 14 Tir a public holiday. Commander Hasanzadeh said the funeral would run 10 to 12 hours on land toward Azadi Square, with prayers set for 8am the following day.

threads.label: Regime messaging around martyrdom narrative
threads.summary: Khamenei's office, Defa Press and IRIB pushed a martyrdom framing, with the Foreign Ministry calling his death 'the beginning of a new phase' and President Pezeshkian writing that 'the flag will not fall'. Defa Press cited RIA Novosti and a Sana'a University professor casting Khamenei as a symbol of global resistance, while crowds chanted 'We are the Sajiil missile, the enemy is Israeli'.

threads.label: External reporting on funeral scale and risk
threads.summary: Iran International cited Germany's Die Welt reporting a classified document projecting 1,500 to 3,000 possible deaths across the week-long funeral, and framed the ceremonies as a state effort to recast a wartime death as martyrdom. The Jerusalem Post reported chants of 'Death to America' and 'Revenge, revenge' at the Tehran ceremonies.

threads.label: US-Iran deal reactions and regional readouts
threads.summary: Former Israeli deputy foreign minister Danny Ayalon told the Jerusalem Post the current US-Iran deal amounts to a 'massive surrender' to the Islamic Republic, and a separate JPost podcast with historian Gil Troy discussed US-Israel strains and the Iran war. CENTCOM marked America's 250th on X, and Defa Press circulated a report of a US MH-60S Seahawk crash in the northern Indian Ocean.

threads.label: Iran domestic security and regional militant items
threads.summary: Iran's Ministry of Intelligence, via Defa Press, claimed the dismantling of four operational cells of a 'terrorist-takfiri' group in Sistan and Baluchestan with ten arrests. The Jerusalem Post reported Hamas executed a 47-year-old Gazan accused of helping Israeli strikes that killed senior operatives including Izz al-Din Haddad, and Times of Israel published a podcast on Shia Lebanese turning against Hezbollah.
